data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
Prescriptions dispensed outside a patient’s usual area can have significant implications for cost management and service planning. The Out of Area Dispensing Dashboard in ePACT2 provides visibility of prescribing activity where items have been dispensed in a different geographical area from where they were prescribed.

This dashboard enables SICBLs, ICBs, and practices to monitor the volume and cost of out-of-area dispensing, identify patterns, and assess the impact on local budgets. It includes interactive visualisations and filters that allow users to drill down by organisation, drug category, and time period. By highlighting these variations, the dashboard supports discussions on commissioning arrangements and helps ensure that reimbursement processes are accurate and fair.

The aim of this dashboard is to provide transparency and support financial governance. It helps local health economies understand the drivers behind out-of-area dispensing, such as patient mobility or specialist prescribing requirements, and consider whether interventions are needed. While the dashboard offers valuable insights, it should be used alongside other financial and clinical reports to provide a complete picture of prescribing behaviour. Its intention is to inform strategic planning and promote equitable resource allocation across the NHS.
